title: I thought automated crypto trading was BS… until I tried it myself
author: According_Video221
selftext:
I've been using this platform for a while and, so far, I've been receiving the promising and excellent results. 

I initially came across it while looking into DeFi and automated trading. What caught my attention was that I didn't have to manually trade or sit watching charts all day.

I'm still testing it myself, so I'm not saying it's guaranteed or recommending anyone invest. Just sharing something I'm currently using because I know some people here are interested in automated crypto strategies.

Happy to answer questions about my experience.
